plugins.description: Runs a monday.com consulting engagement from the first call to a signed-off, documented solution in the client's own account: call and document intake, discovery grading, solution blueprint, an approved account build with read-back on every write, an independent audit, demo scripts, a progressive SOP and a two-level close-out, all from one record per client.
